sections.content: A long list of unqualified names creates more outreach work without explaining why anyone should care.

sections.content: Reusing the wrong product context or mixing account data can produce an irrelevant pitch and a difficult handoff.

pages.purpose: Prepare a budgeted autopilot plan, inspect its steps and approve it before execution.

hero.headline: Turn a research goal into a bounded plan.

sections.content: An open-ended research instruction can consume credits without producing a list you would actually use.

content.title: Define the goal
content.body: Describe the desired accounts and the exclusions that matter.

content.title: Review the plan
content.body: Inspect the proposed steps and maximum credit budget.

content.title: Approve and monitor
content.body: Start only after review, then inspect results or pause the plan.

content.title: A visible scope
content.body: The plan makes the intended work inspectable.

content.title: A budget before execution
content.body: Know the proposed allowance before paid research starts.

content.title: A place to intervene

sections.content: Research loses value when the account record has no clear next step.

content.title: Review the account
content.body: Check company identity and the supporting information.

content.title: Set the next action
content.body: Record the follow-up, owner and relevant stage.

content.title: Update from the result
content.body: Keep activity current after a conversation or decision.

content.title: Continuity for follow-up
content.body: The next person can see what already happened.

content.title: A visible pipeline

pages.title: Run one research task you can check.
pages.purpose: Start with a known company and a small question before asking an agent to build a large list.

hero.headline: Run one research task you can check.

sections.content: A broad discovery run is difficult to evaluate if you have not tested identity matching and credit usage.

content.title: Choose a known account
content.body: Use its domain and an unambiguous company name.

content.title: Request one useful fact
content.body: Estimate the credit charge and inspect the returned source.

content.title: Check the record
content.body: Confirm the result is attached to the correct company before expanding the run.

content.title: A clear first success
content.body: You can judge accuracy against a known account.

content.title: A bounded spend
content.body: One task makes it easier to understand usage.

content.title: A safer repeatable process
content.body: Carry the identity check into larger research tasks.

pages.title: Budget the research steps, not just the final list.
pages.purpose: Credits measure priced actions. A single prospect can require several searches and enrichment steps.

hero.headline: Budget the research steps, not just the final list.

sections.content: A claim that a plan buys a fixed number of leads hides differences in research depth and provider results.

content.title: Choose the actions
content.body: List discovery, email lookup, company enrichment and other required steps.

content.title: Multiply by the workload
content.body: Use the published per-action schedule and include planned repeats.

content.title: Set a stopping point
content.body: Review the credit balance and any autopilot budget before increasing the workload.

content.title: A clearer estimate
content.body: The calculation reflects the actual work requested.

content.title: Visible tradeoffs
content.body: Choose which missing facts justify another paid action.

content.title: No promised lead count
content.body: A credit allowance is not a guarantee of contacts or sales.

pages.title: Review the person, the evidence and the message.
pages.purpose: Use research to prepare a relevant follow-up without treating an AI draft as permission to send.

hero.headline: Review the person, the evidence and the message.

sections.content: The wrong identity or an unsupported claim can damage a conversation before it begins.

content.title: Confirm identity
content.body: Match the person with the intended company or domain.

content.title: Check the claim
content.body: Open supporting sources and remove uncertain personalizations.

content.title: Approve the action
content.body: Check sender, recipients, channel permissions and final wording before sending.

content.title: Fewer wrong attachments
content.body: Identity comes before enrichment.

content.title: A more relevant draft
content.body: The message uses facts you can defend.

content.title: A deliberate decision
content.body: You choose whether the communication is appropriate.
